title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 2
why: Gukesh has White in Game 2 of the 14-game world championship match in Geneva after Game 1 was drawn; streamed free on the FIDE YouTube channel.

title: Players Championship Finals, Round One (Stephen Bunting v Max Hopp)
why: Bunting meets Max Hopp in round one at Minehead on Friday 27 November; his session time has not been announced, and Luke Littler is not in the field.
